visualPitch: Photorealistic apex predators across four world ranges — golden savanna, monsoon delta, ember ridge, and boreal quiet — documentary wildlife cinematography (not illustration)

style.aesthetic: photorealistic cinematic wildlife still, BBC Earth / National Geographic production design, natural habitat plates and predator portraits, shallow depth of field, golden hour and blue hour lighting, physically based materials, earnest observe-the-hunt mood (not grimdark, not cartoon)
style.avoid: anime, manga, cartoon, cel shading, watercolor, illustration, concept-art sketch look, painterly brush strokes, neon cyberpunk, purple sci-fi glow, blood, gore, hunting trophies, prominent human faces, zoo signage, text overlays, watermarks, anthropomorphic animals
style.palette: savanna ochre and acacia gold, delta teal and jungle shadow, ridge ember and volcanic stone, boreal slate and frost white

image.promptPrefix: Photorealistic wide cinematic wildlife habitat still,
image.promptSuffix: documentary wildlife photography plate, natural materials and lighting, empty habitat or single predator portrait as specified, no anime, no illustration, no gore, no people, no readable text, no watermark, 16:9 composition.
image.ctaSuffix: photorealistic product/environment still for a trading card game website tile, natural habitat materials, atmospheric depth, documentary mood, no anime, no illustration, no text, no watermark, 16:9 composition.
image.gamemodelSuffix: photorealistic square environment still for a trading card game website section, natural habitat materials, centered composition, documentary lighting, no anime, no illustration, no text, no watermark, 1:1 aspect ratio.
image.cardTypeSuffix: photorealistic metallic emblem prop photo for a trading card game UI, brushed metal and enamel, clean silhouette, no anime, no illustration, no text, no watermark, 1:1 aspect ratio.
